run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T01:43:20Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on service frontend coincides with errors confined to the ad-dependent route: at 2026-11-17T01:43:20Z frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate was 0.522/s and its error-span increase sat on GET, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, executing api route (pages) /api/data and GET /api/data (36.67 spans/5m each) plus tcp.connect (10), while /api/cart, /api/checkout, /api/products/{productId} and /api/recommendations had zero error spans. The only ad pod, otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5, was Running but not ready with restartCount 4 and container termination reason OOMKilled (exitCode 137) in both lastState and current state, with Warning BackOff events starting 2026-11-17T01:42:34Z; the ad Deployment's container memory limit is 450Mi, its ReplicaSet reported no ready replicas, and the ad Service endpoints held only notReadyAddresses. In chaos-mesh, Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress spawned a new StressChaos every minute from 01:41:25Z and each successful apply names otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad as its target, so a memory-stress fault was applied to exactly the pod being OOM-killed about a minute later, just before frontend errors began around 01:42:50Z. Because the fault-injection chain rests on Kubernetes events (chaos-mesh custom resources were not readable and the alerting rule definition was not returned), the conclusion is partial; the hypothesis that this Schedule caused the OOM kills and hence the frontend errors is consistent but not directly observed at the chaos-spec level.

claims.text: At 2026-11-17T01:43:20Z frontend had a STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate of 0.522/s and frontend-proxy 0.2556/s. Frontend's error-span increase in the preceding 5 minutes was concentrated on span_name GET, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, executing api route (pages) /api/data and GET /api/data (36.67 each) plus tcp.connect (10); GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, POST /api/checkout, GET /api/products/{productId} and GET /api/recommendations had 0 error spans.

The frontend error-span increase was 0 at every 30-second evaluation up to 01:42:20Z and became 156.67 from 01:42:50Z onward, so the frontend errors began approximately 01:42:50Z, i.e. after the first ad-pod restart warnings. A separate 10-minute series was 0 at 01:20:00Z, 01:30:00Z and 01:40:00Z.

Pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958) was Running but not ready: ready=false, started=false, restartCount=4, lastState.terminated reason OOMKilled with exitCode 137 finishedAt 2026-11-17T01:44:34Z, and state.terminated reason OOMKilled exitCode 137 finishedAt 2026-11-17T01:45:36Z; the Ready condition has been False (ContainersNotReady: [ad]) since 2026-11-17T01:45:37Z.

Warning reason BackOff events for container ad in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 begin at 2026-11-17T01:42:34Z and total 23 occurrences through 01:50:13Z; Normal Created and Started events for that container count 6 (firstTimestamp 01:04:58Z/01:04:59Z, lastTimestamp 01:47:05Z), consistent with repeated restarts after 01:42.

The ad Deployment (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, 1 replica) sets container limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi and requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi; its ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 is owned by Deployment ad and reports 1 replica with no readyReplicas/availableReplicas, and the ad Service endpoints contain only notReadyAddresses for 100.96.2.230 (pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5).

In namespace chaos-mesh, kind Schedule name otel-demo-ad-memory-stress emitted Spawned events creating StressChaos objects otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq (01:41:25Z), -7n9mk (01:42:25Z), -8b272 (01:43:25Z), -sh425 (01:44:25Z), -w8tqb (01:45:25Z), -w4ct8 (01:46:25Z), -w98sl (01:48:15Z) and -9ncrx (01:49:10Z). The corresponding StressChaos events record 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' and a Recovered/TimeUp roughly 55 seconds later (e.g. Apply at 01:41:25Z, Time up at 01:42:20Z; Apply at 01:42:25Z, Time up at 01:43:20Z).

Only the ad pod shows a degraded pod state in otel-demo: the pod table shows ad-554b849958-l9ft5 running with ready=false and restartCount 4, while accounting, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping and valkey-cart pods are all Running with ready=true and restartCount 0, including the pods co-located on node i-0d81a0f472ebdc704.

The ad service's own spans do not carry error status on GetAds: at 01:43:20Z ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds STATUS_CODE_UNSET increase was 214.44 over 5 minutes with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, and ad's only error series, flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (1.05 over 10 minutes in the window ending 01:50Z), was 0 at 01:30:00Z and 01:40:00Z.

The ad container's memory working set was about 354 MB (354.64 MiB at 01:43:20Z) against its 450Mi limit for the container instance reporting before the restart, and two new container IDs for the same pod began reporting working set in that window (2.55 MiB at 01:42:35Z rising to 63.72 MiB, and 2.18 MiB at 01:43:10Z rising to 56.66 MiB), consistent with container replacement near 01:42-01:43.

Most likely causal chain: the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress repeatedly applied memory stress to the sole ad pod's container (stress applied from 01:41:25Z), whose 450Mi memory limit was exceeded, causing OOMKilled (exit 137) and repeated restarts; while the container was down the ad Service had no ready endpoint, so frontend's /api/data route failed on its grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect spans from about 01:42:50Z, producing the frontend error rate that triggered RequestErrorRate at 01:43:20Z.

The frontend-proxy error spans are most likely a downstream symptom of frontend returning failing responses rather than an independent fault: at 01:43:20Z frontend-proxy's 5-minute error increase of 76.67 equals the sum of its own 'router frontend egress' (37.78) and 'ingress' (38.89) error-span increases, and frontend's error increase in the same window was 156.67.

A frontend application regression is not supported: frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is ready with restartCount 0, and frontend's error spans at 01:43:20Z were limited to the ad-dependent /api/data path (GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, tcp.connect) while its cart, checkout, product and recommendation routes had zero error spans.

Node-wide memory pressure on i-0d81a0f472ebdc704 is not supported: every other otel-demo pod on that node (including accounting, cart, currency, email, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, recommendation, shipping and valkey-cart) is ready with restartCount 0, while the OOM kill and BackOff events name only the ad pod, which the chaos events explicitly target.

The ad service was not completely unavailable: at 01:43:20Z its oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans still recorded an increase of 214.44 over 5 minutes with STATUS_CODE_UNSET and no error status, which is consistent with intermittent restarts rather than a total outage, and it means the ad service's own span data does not by itself show failed requests.

Human follow-up: stop or suspend the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh (and its StressChaos children) so the ad pod stops being memory-stressed, then confirm the ad pod becomes Ready and the ad Service has ready endpoints; separately review whether the ad container's 450Mi memory limit leaves enough headroom for its workload, and avoid running memory-stress experiments against this single-replica service in a monitored environment.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule definition was not retrievable: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate (no_data) and without filters (no_data) both returned no rule groups, so the exact expression producing the annotation value 2.622222222222222 is unverified.

The chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and its StressChaos objects could not be read as Kubernetes objects (chaos-mesh custom resource kinds are not in the available kind list), so the memory stressor size, selector, duration and mode are unverified; the fault injection is evidenced only by their events.

The ad container's previous-instance logs were unavailable (HTTP 400: previous terminated container "ad" not found), so no application-level pre-termination message was read; the OOM evidence is the container status termination reason and exit code, not a log line.

Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend in 01:40-01:50Z (traces_search twice, status no_data, and the error=true tag search, status no_data) although frontend's 22 operations are listed in Jaeger, so gRPC status codes and error text of the failing GetAds spans are unknown.
Frontend application logs for 01:41:00-01:43:40Z returned no lines (two fetches, status no_data), so the frontend's own error messages around the onset are not available.

Frontend/frontend-proxy error series queries evaluated at 01:58:00Z returned no series (status no_data), and the delivered metric data ends around 01:43:20Z, so whether the error rate and ad crash loop persisted after the queried window is unknown rather than zero.

Metric metadata queries for http_server_request_duration_seconds_count, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count and kube_replicaset_owner returned nothing (status no_data), so HTTP/gRPC server-side error codes and kube-state ownership metrics for the ad ReplicaSet were unavailable; ownership was established from the Kubernetes ReplicaSet object instead.
Whether the ad pod was Ready before 01:42:34Z is not provable from current object state; only the current not-ready condition and the 01:42:34Z first BackOff event are observed.
next_steps: Read the actual RequestErrorRate rule (its PromQL and labels) from the alerting rule source to confirm how 2.622222222222222 is computed and that it keys on frontend error spans.

Inspect the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and StressChaos specs (stressor memory size, target selector, duration, mode) with a chaos-mesh-capable client to confirm the injection matches the OOM path.
Capture the ad container's crash-time logs and any node/kubelet OOMKilling records now that the container has been restarted, and check container_memory_working_set_bytes around each kill.
Verify current ad pod readiness and ad Service endpoints after stopping the chaos schedule, and confirm the frontend error rate returned to baseline.
